key.name: enable-animations
key.description: Whether the HUD uses open/close animations.

key.name: show-copy-button
key.description: Whether the HUD shows a button to copy the displayed system information to the clipboard.

key.name: refresh-interval-ms
key.description: Base data fetch interval in milliseconds. Lower values refresh more often, while higher values reduce load and improve smoothness.

key.name: window-width-percent
key.description: HUD width as a percentage of the primary monitor.

key.name: window-height-percent
key.description: HUD height as a percentage of the primary monitor.

key.name: show-power-section
key.description: Whether the battery and power section is shown.

key.name: show-cpu-graph
key.description: Whether the per-core CPU history graph is shown.
